primary_gt.rejected_alternative: local dry-weather or heat-led proof fails the dryness threshold

event.event_name: August-September 2000 southern Africa biomass-burning aerosol and smoke episode

formulas.haze_fraction: count(nonblack pixels with 70<=luma<=220 and saturation<=0.20) / count(nonblack pixels)

decision_rule.final_label_rule: source_count, scene_haze_change, and low_ventilation must pass; local_dryness is tested as a rejected local-weather alternative

key_values.weather_context_scope: Daily wind and precipitation are used as package-provided event-window context; coordinate/AOI metadata are not part of the scored evidence.

criteria.name: requested_json_structure
criteria.description: Returns the metrics object, pass/fail object, final consistency label, and short rejected alternative.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for parseable JSON with one missing object or minor field-name mismatch; award 1 point for mostly correct content outside strict JSON.

criteria.name: numeric_anchors_and_formulas
criteria.description: Computes source-region count, haze ratio, mean wind, low-wind fraction, precipitation total, and dry-day fraction with correct units and formulas.
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit by metric family: up to 1 point for source count, 1.5 for image haze ratio, 1.5 for wind values, and 1 for precipitation values when formulas are mostly correct.

criteria.name: threshold_decisions
criteria.description: Correctly marks source count, scene haze change, and low ventilation as pass, and local dryness as fail.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for each correct pass/fail state; do not award a point for a state whose threshold direction is reversed.

criteria.name: calculation_reasoning
criteria.description: Shows the image haze calculation and daily weather aggregation as explicit numeric checks.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1.5 points for the image calculation path and 1.5 points for the weather aggregation path if one path is incomplete.

criteria.name: rejected_alternative
criteria.description: Rejects a local dry-weather or heat-led proof using the failed dryness test and small heat load.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for rejecting either local dryness or heat-led proof with a correct numeric reason.

criteria.name: concise_consistency_label
criteria.description: Uses a short final consistency label that follows from the pass/fail tests.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 point for an equivalent but wordier label that preserves the three passing tests.

criteria.name: no_uncomputed_escalation
criteria.description: Avoids adding measured health-impact, road-closure, or burn-scar severity assertions not computed by the ledger.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 point for one minor extra assertion that does not change the final label.

provenance.notes: All numeric anchors are derived from local CSX-206 package files. Scoring uses declared package-relative files, extracted statistics, formulas, and provenance rather than coordinate/AOI metadata.
